value: `helm install cilium oci://quay.io/cilium/charts/cilium --version v1.20.2 --namespace kube-system` fails with "chart not found". What is the likeliest cause?
reason: The old front passed the version as a third positional argument, which `helm install NAME CHART` rejects before it looks for the chart; with `--version` the command fails only because of the "v" prefix, as the docs' troubleshooting note says.

value: No. `--hubble-redact-enabled` switches redaction on, and each kind has its own option, such as `--hubble-redact-http-urlquery`.
reason: The docs pair --hubble-redact-enabled with a separate option per redaction feature, so the one flag alone does not redact anything named on the front.

value: The static exporter serves the Hubble metrics named in that list, so Hubble must be on and each wanted metric must be listed.
reason: "No metrics are exported until you name the set" is not stated on the page; the new wording keeps to what the docs say.
